# Pull Request

## What Problem Does This Solve?

Describe the problem and why this change is needed.

## Change Type

- [ ] Runtime
- [ ] Schema
- [ ] Bridge
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Other

## Interoperability

Does this affect ROS2 interoperability, DDS behavior, MCAP compatibility, simulator integration, or vendor SDK integration?

## Replayability

Does this affect live/replay symmetry, logging, dataset loading, clocks, or deterministic replay assumptions?

## Observability

Does this affect graph inspection, latency, drops, QoS diagnostics, frame diagnostics, lifecycle events, or policy diagnostics?

## Transport Assumptions

Does this introduce or strengthen an assumption about a specific transport, language runtime, simulator, ML framework, or robotics framework?

## Safety / Authority

Does this affect actuator authority, command gating, policy outputs, safety monitors, or emergency stop behavior?

## Testing

How was this tested?

## Notes

Add migration notes, open questions, or follow-up work.
